SYMPTOM: Keyboard appears over text fields in exercises/chat — content doesn't scroll up when keyboard opens.
CAUSE: When a ZStack has `Color.background.ignoresSafeArea()` as a background layer, it tells SwiftUI to ignore ALL safe areas including keyboard insets. This propagates to all sibling views in the ZStack, disabling SwiftUI's automatic keyboard avoidance.
FIX: Change `.ignoresSafeArea()` → `.ignoresSafeArea(.container)`. The `.container` parameter only ignores device safe areas (notch, home indicator) but NOT keyboard.
PREVENT: Never use bare `.ignoresSafeArea()` on a background Color inside a ZStack that contains text input views. Always specify `.ignoresSafeArea(.container)` or `.ignoresSafeArea(.all)` intentionally.
